test.title: A live performance you went to, such as a concert or a play

document.cue: Describe a live performance you went to, such as a concert or a play.

text: I'd like to talk about a concert I went to last spring at the Palace of the Republic in Almaty. It was a folk-rock band that mixes traditional Kazakh instruments with electric guitars, and my older brother had bought the tickets as a birthday present, so I didn't really know what to expect.

The hall was completely full, and the audience was surprisingly mixed — there were teenagers, families with children and quite a few elderly couples. The band opened with a slow piece on the dombra and the kobyz, and then suddenly the drums came in and the whole place started clapping along.

The moment I remember best was near the end, when the lead singer asked everyone to switch off their phones for one song. At first people hesitated, but within a minute the hall was dark and silent apart from the music. It felt as if we were all sharing the same experience rather than filming it.

I think it stayed with me because it changed my attitude to traditional music. I'd always thought of it as something for official ceremonies, but that evening it sounded modern and powerful. Since then I've actually started learning a few simple tunes on the dombra myself.
So a present I wasn't very excited about turned into one of the best evenings of the year.
